title: Error rate spike on the student portal search endpoint
description: 1,847 requests to /api/search from one address in 11 minutes, 94% returning HTTP 500. Normal error rate for this endpoint is under 0.2%.

title: Anomalous request signatures on a public endpoint
description: Requests to /api/search contain SQL metacharacters and keywords. The portal has no web application firewall in front of it, so nothing is blocking them.

title: Search engine crawler activity
description: Googlebot indexing the public portal pages. Expected traffic, respecting robots.txt.

title: Application returning stack traces to clients
description: The /api/search error response included a database exception with the failing SQL statement, the ORM library and version. Debug output is enabled in production.

title: Portal administrator signed in from an external address
description: The portal admin account authenticated successfully from 203.0.113.188 - the same address generating the malformed search requests. The account is not enrolled in MFA.

title: Bulk student export downloaded
description: A 4.4 MB CSV export of the student register was downloaded through the admin interface by the session that authenticated from 203.0.113.188.
